## Changes
- **The insertion search shows the right saving.** On an ascent with a free argument of periapsis, AFC searches for the insertion that costs the least burn. It priced some insertions too high and left others unpriced, so the saving it showed could be much too small. Each insertion is now priced from a clean start: the search prices every insertion of its grid, shows the saving of the best one and needs about a quarter of the solves. ([#162](https://github.com/Maximilian-Nesslauer/KSA-AdvancedFlightComputer/pull/162))
- **Stacks with solid boosters and a throttle floor hand over to UPFG without a large turn.** On such a stack, the climb plan with a stage held at full thrust often did not converge, so the plan kept that stage throttled, and the steering turned by up to 43 degrees when UPFG took over. That plan now converges, and the plan and UPFG hand over a few degrees apart. The LAUNCH page shows the mass as "TO ORBIT IN THE PLAN". If a throttled plan is ever kept, the page says which stage it throttles, that the flight delivers less, and that the steering turns at the hand-over. ([#164](https://github.com/Maximilian-Nesslauer/KSA-AdvancedFlightComputer/pull/164))

## Known limits
- Flights deliver a few percent less mass to orbit than the plan shows.
- Next to a staging step, the saving that the insertion search shows can be larger than the saving that is flown.

AFC needs StarMap and no other mod.
